title: wb init hangs in a terminal on a repo with no commits
desc:
profile._contributors runs git shortlog -sn --all --no-merges without stdin. In a repo with no commits --all names no revision, so git shortlog reads the log from stdin; from a terminal that never ends, and each call waits out its 20 s timeout. wb init --write took over 60 s and was killed in the WB-49 benchmark preflight from PowerShell; it passes from Git Bash, whose stdin is already closed. Reproduced: git shortlog -sn --all --no-merges in a fresh git init with an open pipe as stdin hangs, and returns at once with stdin=DEVNULL.

ACCEPTANCE:
- no subprocess wb starts inherits the caller's stdin (profile's shortlog at least; gitctx's git calls too)
- regression test: contributor detection in a repo with no commits returns promptly with an open stdin
- structure test: every subprocess.run under lib passes stdin
